tooltip.value: Locke throws a binding artifact to a location, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and Slowing enemies in the area by {{ slowamount*100 }}%, decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds. The artifact marks enemies hit for {{ duration }} seconds, sealing away marked enemy champions brought below {{ executetooltipcalc }} , and resetting the duration of the mark on other affected champions. After the duration ends, if at least one champion was sealed, the artifact lands on the ground. lore.value: A nail-slinging exorcist versed in forbidden rites, Corvin Locke is the progeny of Demacian occultists. Born into lies and hypocrisy, he learned young that demons aren't the cause of humanity's darkness, but the consequence. Now, Locke tears through every soul, exposing its darkness, intent on making the world a more honest place… one exorcism at a time.
